page.overview:
Who is Joan Cunningham?

Corey Cunningham (son; deceased) Ronald Prevo (husband; deceased)

Category:Halloween Ends characters Category:Female characters Category:Mothers Category:Victims of Corey Cunningham Joan Cunningham is a character in Halloween Ends, portrayed by Joanne Baron. She is the mother of Corey Cunningham and the wife of Ronald Prevo.

Joan is known to be highly protective of Corey, getting angry whenever he speaks to other girls. When Corey tells her he is leaving the house to be with Allyson, she slaps him, but immediately regrets it. Joan is ultimately stabbed to death by her own son after he has had enough of her.
